purpose: Defines terminal acquisition-method coverage for all 98 WHR tiers without conflating method completeness, runner implementation, observed evidence rank, or publication policy.
closure_rules: exactly 98 unique tiers must exist and cover 1 through 98
country_id must match the slug for the same delivery_no in docs/country-pages/98-country-tracker.tsv
every record must contain at least one source_id and an http(s) primary_source_url
method_class determines trigger_class, zero_policy, and runner_state
method_complete must be true for every record
rank fields are forbidden because acquisition method coverage does not define observed evidence rank or publication rank
